data.body: Evidence 2026-11-04 PST: `tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py::test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass` crashed its xdist worker in the integration tier of `make verify` (worktree fix-caudata), and alone it hit the 300 s pytest-timeout with the stack in `_lib_mutations.comment` -> `_lib_warn.emit_cross_session_warning` -> `show_ticket` -> `config.load_config`. Paired runs with --timeout=1800 at host load average ~28: base `8f12601dfdb` 302.78 s call, `1e585fdd0f5` 316.61 s call (1 sample each), both passing. So at this load the test exceeds the default 300 s budget on main independent of that change.
